tweet_summary: A viral 'Worth Sharing' post presents an image of a smiling female F-15E pilot posing with three Kuwaiti men after she was supposedly shot down in a friendly-fire incident, framing it as a real heartwarming rescue moment.
why_note_decision: The underlying event is real (Kuwaiti air defenses mistakenly shot down three US F-15Es on Mar 1 2026; all six crew ejected safely and locals did help), but the specific image in the post is AI-generated/fabricated, not authentic footage of the incident. Snopes confirmed the image contains Google SynthID watermarking and AI artifacts. A note is warranted to flag that the heartwarming photo is not a real depiction.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that the IMAGE in this post is fabricated/AI-generated and does not depict the real incident. It should ideally avoid over-claiming that the whole event is fake — the friendly-fire shootdown and pilots ejecting safely DID happen, and at least one real local did help a downed pilot. A correct note may cite tells of AI fabrication (e.g. the slung rifle a fighter pilot would not carry, SynthID/AI artifacts). It must NOT assert the event itself never occurred. A note that only debunks the rifle detail without flagging the image as AI/fabricated is weaker but acceptable; full credit requires identifying the image as fabricated.
reference_note: The post's image is a fabricated meme not depicting the incident. F-15E pilots do not carry slung assault rifles, and the staged posing does not match real ejection videos showing locals reassuring crew.    https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVZRLE7DI4K/  https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/f-15-female-pilot-shot-down-over-kuwait-thanked-by-locals-5HjdTmT_2  https://www.reddit.com/r/isthisAI/comments/1rjtzn4/comments_on_fb_post_are_mixed_as_to_whether_this/

fact_check.notes: Kuwait shot down three US F-15Es in a friendly-fire incident Mar 1 2026; all crew safe. The circulating image of a pilot posing with locals is AI-generated (Snopes: contains SynthID). The real event happened; the photo does not depict it.

importance.lens_rationale: 452k impressions on a war/military incident; AI-fabricated imagery muddying a real geopolitical event degrades public information quality — moderate epistemic stakes.
